root_cause_reason: The live helper redirected Python stdout/stderr to a dedicated log, while the wrapper deleted that log and launch marker when systemd-run returned nonzero. The system journal therefore retained only the generic child exit status, not the underlying Python exception.
timing_hypothesis_nonbinding: Approximately six seconds is consistent with four immediately failing request attempts plus 1+2+3 second retry sleeps, so the first Bybit public request is a leading diagnostic hypothesis, not a concluded cause.
strategy_review_reason: Technical host-wrapper observability failure only; no economic/source-feasibility verdict was obtained.
required_fix: preserve log and exit-code artifacts on failure
mirror live Python output to both journal and persistent log
preserve launch marker for attempt provenance
print status/log automatically when the transient unit fails
use a new versioned wrapper and a new exact approval boundary
